headline: 4xtra Arrested for Attempted Murder: $1M Bail Set
body: DJ Akademiks reports former 'No Jumper' host 4xtra (real name Resan Bingham) has been booked by LAPD Wednesday morning on attempted murder charges. Police records indicate bail is set at $1 million. TMZ has confirmed the arrest details through law enforcement sources. The incident remains under investigation with no public details disclosed yet.
